newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Bank Corp elects president.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Bank Corp elects president.

text.p: Peoples Bank Corp of Indianapolis said Thursday it named Gerald Francis, its executive vice president-retail banking, to the post of president.

William McWhirter, who served as the bank's president since 1984, was elected chairman and chief executive officer. McWhirter will succeed his father, F.T. McWhirter, who had served as chairman since 1972 and is assuming the post of chairman emeritus, Peoples Bank said.
Peoples Bank operates bank offices in the Indianapolis metropolitan area.
Its shares closed up 1-3/4 Thursday at 45-1/4.
